title: print vs println
instructions: What is the difference between `print()` and `println()`?

options.text: println adds a newline at the end, print does not
print adds a newline at the end, println does not
println can only print strings, print can print any type

explanation: println (print line) outputs text and then moves the cursor to the next line. print outputs text but keeps the cursor on the same line, so the next print or println call continues from there.
